final: WITH t AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, AVG(tr.UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(tr.Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(tr.Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track tr JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = tr.MediaTypeId WHERE tr.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall FROM t) SELECT t.name, t.avg_price, t.avg_bytes_per_ms, t.avg_bytes_per_ms / a.overall AS ratio_to_overall FROM t CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.overall IS NOT NULL
